title: Logarithm Property
text: A key property of logarithms is that log(10^n) = n. This makes calculations with powers of 10 very straightforward.

title: Applying the Decibel Formula
text: L = 10 log(10^7) = 10 x 7 = 70 dB. The decibel scale is logarithmic because human hearing perceives loudness logarithmically. Every 10 dB increase represents a 10-fold increase in intensity.
